description: This Java interface defines the AssetRepository, a data access object (DAO) for AssetEntity objects, providing various query methods for retrieving asset data with filtering, joining, and pagination capabilities within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for AssetEntity, providing database query methods for asset data.

methods.name: findAssetInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info by asset ID, joining with customer and profile data.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant ID with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info list for a tenant with optional search, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds assets for a tenant and customer with optional search, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndProfileId
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant and profile ID with optional search, paginated.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info for tenant and customer, with search, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant ID and list of asset IDs.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant ID, customer ID, and list of asset IDs.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an asset by tenant ID and exact name.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Retrieves entity info list with names starting with a prefix.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant ID and type with optional search, paginated.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info filtered by tenant and type.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant and profile ID with search, paginated.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info by tenant and profile ID.

methods.name: findAssetIdsByTenantIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds asset IDs by tenant and profile ID with optional search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant, customer, and type with search, paginated.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves detailed asset info for tenant, customer, and type.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds detailed asset info by tenant, customer, profile ID.

methods.name: countByAssetProfileId
methods.description: Counts assets by profile ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds assets related to an edge by edge ID, with search, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets related to an edge by edge ID and type, with search, paginated.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts total assets for a tenant.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for an asset by its internal ID.

methods.name: getAllAssetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all distinct asset types with pagination.

methods.name: findAllFields
methods.description: Finds all asset fields with ID greater than a specified value, limited by a limit.
